prompt: Write 5 short claim log entries by an auto insurance adjuster for a rear-end collision claim. Injury: shoulder injury. The claimant is not represented by a lawyer. Start each entry on a new line with 'Entry 1:', 'Entry 2:' and so on. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1223; do not mention it.)
text:
Entry 1: Claim opened following a rear-end collision at a signalized intersection. Insured vehicle was stopped at the light when struck from behind by a third-party vehicle. Claimant reports pain in the right shoulder and neck since the impact. Claimant is not represented by an attorney. Recorded statement scheduled for the coming week; photos of both vehicles requested from the insured.

Entry 2: Recorded statement obtained from the claimant. Claimant states the impact was moderate, airbags did not deploy, and they were seated with the seatbelt fastened. Claimant describes ongoing right shoulder pain with limited overhead reach and difficulty sleeping on that side. Claimant has scheduled an appointment with a primary care provider and has not yet received imaging. Advised claimant that medical records and bills should be forwarded once available.

Entry 3: Police report received and reviewed. Report notes the third-party driver admitted to looking at a phone before the collision and was cited for following too closely. Liability appears clear in favor of the claimant. Vehicle damage estimate received from the body shop and is under review. Diary set to follow up on the claimant's medical treatment status.

Entry 4: Claimant called to report a physical therapy referral following an orthopedic evaluation. Claimant states the shoulder is improving slowly but still painful with lifting. Requested itemized medical bills and treatment notes via the authorization form, which was sent to the claimant by mail and email. Reminded claimant that they may wish to consult an attorney but that they are free to handle the claim directly. No legal representation has been reported to date.

Entry 5: Medical records received from the treating provider, including diagnosis of a right rotator cuff strain and a recommended course of physical therapy. Bills reviewed for reasonableness against the fee schedule. Claimant's vehicle repair is complete and the rental period has ended. Reserve reviewed and adjusted to reflect current medical and property exposure. File remains open pending completion of therapy and a final medical status update.
